### 2.2 Basic Definitions
- **Non-local game $G$**: $(N, X, Y, \pi, V)$ where:
  - $N$: number of players
  - $X = X_1 \times \cdots \times X_N$: question sets
  - $Y = Y_1 \times \cdots \times Y_N$: answer sets
  - $\pi$: probability distribution over questions
  - $V$: winning condition function $V(y_1,\ldots,y_N | x_1,\ldots,x_N)$

- **Classical value $\omega_c(G)$**: maximum winning probability with classical strategies
- **Quantum value $\omega_q(G)$**: maximum with quantum strategies
- **No-signaling value $\omega_{ns}(G)$**: maximum with no-signaling correlations

### 2.3 Fundamental Examples
- CHSH game (2-player, 2-question, 2-answer)
- Magic Square game (pseudo-telepathy)
- Parallel repetition
